notes.title: All brands in the app
notes.note: The left pull-down opens with All, and the page behind it travels inside the APK: a tab per brand over a sheet of twenty icons, one from each category, so the two sets can be read side by side with the radio off.

notes.title: Estimate under Export
notes.note: The zip estimate moved into the line under the Export button, where the running summary used to be, and the collected icons now wrap into rows instead of running off the edge of the tab.

notes.title: Pick what you export
notes.note: Double-tap an icon in the sheet and it collects into a tab above it, with Remove selected and Remove all. Add all takes the whole category, and a category change starts the selection clean. The line under the preview estimates the zip before you press Export.

notes.title: Format in a list
notes.note: Format is a pull-down like the size: SVG, PNG, WEBP or JPG, one at a time, and the copy button renames itself to match. The two lists never open together.

notes.title: Black or white, remembered
notes.note: Your background choice now sticks per brand alongside the format and the size, so a white tile survives a reload and the exports come back on white.

notes.title: One size, in a list
notes.note: The export size is now a pull-down holding all six sizes from 32 to 1024px, instead of a row that had to squeeze. What you pick still carries over to the zip.

notes.title: Sizes on two rows, and a pasteable PNG
notes.note: The six export sizes now sit on two rows, so none of them is squeezed. The format and size you pick are remembered per brand, and on the site copying a raster also puts a PNG on the clipboard to paste straight into a design tool.

notes.title: Whole sets at any size
notes.note: The export size now runs from 32 to 1024px, and one button packs every icon the sheet shows into a single zip, in the format you picked. Inside the app that zip lands in Downloads/Icons.

notes.title: Exports
notes.note: Copy hands over the SVG, or a 512px PNG, WEBP or JPG drawn on the black or white background. The app saves those to Pictures/Icons.

notes.title: Clear of the cutout
notes.note: The browser is inset below the status bar and a camera cutout, so the band is no longer clipped. A page the app does not carry now offers the site address and an Open on the web button.

notes.title: Plain backgrounds
notes.note: The preview tile is a black or white swatch now, labelled as such, instead of the palette’s field and band.

notes.title: It remembers
notes.note: The category you picked last is restored the next time you open a brand, and All icons forgets it.

notes.title: Categories
notes.note: Both sets filter by their vendor's own categories — Coolicons' 30, Lineicons' 51 — beside the name filter. The weight control now writes the chosen stroke onto every element, and fills the dots the stroke would otherwise turn inside out.

notes.title: First build
notes.note: Both brands, 1,864 icons, bundled with the pages, the stylesheet and Poppins. WebView on a private origin so fetch and the clipboard behave exactly as they do on the site.

notes.title: Preview and variants
notes.note: A preview tab with weight, size and background, and a copy button that hands over the untouched SVG.

notes.title: The set folds away
notes.note: All icons sit behind one toggle and scroll inside their own sheet instead of filling the page.

notes.title: No permissions
notes.note: Not even INTERNET: the browser is inside the APK, so there is nothing to request.

notes.title: Poppins
notes.note: Every heading, label and number is set in Poppins instead of the system font and its mono captions.

notes.title: One field
notes.note: The app is indigo with band-grey actions and hairline rules where thick ink borders used to be.

notes.title: One palette
notes.note: The dark-mode toggle is gone because the design carries a single palette. Nothing else about compressing photos changed.

notes.title: Mark
notes.note: The logo sits at the bottom left of the main screen, next to a MORE APPS link back to this shelf.

notes.title: Adding photos
notes.note: Picking when some are queued asks first: Add more appends, Start from beginning replaces, Cancel leaves it alone.
